kyoto_il_lago_bacaro.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: pastas (penne with Gorgonzola cream, Genovese with shrimp), fried blue crab and maitake fritters (2026 reviews).
kyoto_il_lago_bacaro.vegan_detail: Not vegan: cicchetti, prosciutto, pâté, cheese and seafood pastas (2026 reviews). Some vegetable plates (marinated purple cabbage, eggplant with balsamic), but no vegan menu is mentioned.
kyoto_il_lago_bacaro.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Wed 15:00–24:00 (food L.O. 22:00, drinks 23:30); Fri–Sun 15:00–1:00 (food L.O. 23:00, drinks 0:30); 15:00–17:00 drinks and light snacks, then dinner and bar; light snacks only after 22:00. Closed Thursday and other irregular days — check the shop's Instagram. Reservations taken; dessert plates by phone; courses by the day before. Standing at the counter is free; tables carry a ¥400 seat charge at dinner — Tabelog, Japanese original 「スタンディングはチャージなし、テーブルはお席代400円」. 36 places: 20 standing, 16 at high tables. Non-smoking. Cards, e-money and QR. English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog). Children welcome.
kyoto_il_lago_bacaro.notes: [Italian standing bar · Kawaramachi-Sanjo, a Venetian bacaro] A Venice-style bacaro near City Hall: stand at the front counter for cicchetti and a glass of wine from about ¥1,800, or take a high table for pasta, fritters and courses. Open from 3 pm to midnight or 1 am; English menu. ¥400 table charge, standing free. Closed Thursday.

roles: Operator: 株式会社HOTTA (NTA invoice registration at the shop address)
chef_bio.background: Opened 3 November 2017 (Tabelog). 2026 reviewers describe a lively place, popular with diners in their 20s, used for girls' nights and birthdays, with attentive staff and an extensive wine list; weekday tables were nearly fully booked in August 2026 while the standing counter was quiet.
chef_bio.philosophy: Modeled on the bacari of Venice (September 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Cicchetti; pastas; Italian wine by the glass.

anecdotes.text: September 2026: "I had researched beforehand and found this Italian place inspired by the bacari of Venice, which opens at 3:00 PM… Leaning against the counter while chatting casually with the staff and sipping beer was fantastic."
April 2026: "The marinated purple cabbage was especially delicious, so I ordered it twice. The wine selection was also extensive."

kyoto_wagyu_ichinone.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: sukiyaki simmered in a sweet secret sauce (warishita) that reviewers say comes from a long-established Japanese restaurant in Fukui (April–May 2026 reviews); soy-based sauces normally contain wheat.
kyoto_wagyu_ichinone.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an A5 Wagyu sukiyaki shop; egg yolk and cheese in the finishing rice (2026 reviews).
kyoto_wagyu_ichinone.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon and Wed–Sun and holidays 12:00–21:00; closed Tuesday. Reservations taken. 12 seats: 8 at the counter and private rooms for 2 and 4 (sunken kotatsu seating per a 2026 review); private hire up to 20. Non-smoking. Cards (incl. UnionPay), e-money and QR (incl. Alipay, WeChat Pay). Basement of the 祇園ファーストビル on the Shijo-dori approach to Yasaka Shrine, about a minute from the shrine. Opened 1 May 2026.
kyoto_wagyu_ichinone.notes: [Wagyu sukiyaki · Gion by Yasaka Shrine, a basement counter] A new (May 2026) basement counter a minute from Yasaka Shrine serving one-person A5 Wagyu sukiyaki bubbling in a hot stone pot — about ¥4,700–5,300 for 120g — finished with cheesy stone-grilled rice. Open from noon. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 1 May 2026 (Tabelog). The listing says each cut of Wagyu is chosen by a master connoisseur; a May 2026 reviewer calls the sauce a company secret, and an April 2026 reviewer says it comes from a long-established Japanese restaurant in Fukui. Reviewers describe the staff cooking the sukiyaki for the diner. Operator not identified; one April 2026 review was written at a pre-opening tasting.
chef_bio.specialty: Stone-pot A5 Wagyu sukiyaki; cheese stone-grilled rice.

anecdotes.text: April 2026: "The dipping sauce deserves special mention. Sourced from a long-established Japanese restaurant in Fukui, its balance of sweetness and richness elevates the meat's flavor."
May 2026: "You don't have to worry about cooking it yourself; it's delicious right from the start… The secret sauce is a company secret."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 和牛一乃音 WAGYU ICHINONE、すき焼き・牛料理、東山区祇園町北側281-1-1 祇園ファーストビル B1F、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、月・水〜日・祝 12:00〜21:00、火曜休み、予約可、12席 (カウンター8席、2名・4名の個室)、貸切20名まで、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR可、2026年5月1日オープン、目利きが選ぶ和牛を石焼で。口コミ (2026年4月〜6月、英語、うち1件はプレオープン): 一人用の石焼すき焼き、A5ミスジまたはA5ロースを60g・120g・180gで、A5ミスジ120g 4,700円、A5ロース120g 5,300円、割り下は福井の老舗日本料理店のものとの記載、七味と山椒、締めはチーズの石焼ごはん (卵黄入り)、八坂神社から徒歩1分。

kyoto_saidokoro_yasukawa.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a Kyoto oden shop whose menu runs to croquettes, ham and tenderloin cutlets, fried oysters, shrimp fry and fried sardines; oden includes chikuwa and other fish cakes (2023–2026 reviews). Ask about plain oden items such as daikon and egg — the broth was not described.
kyoto_saidokoro_yasukawa.vegan_detail: Not vegan: oden in dashi with egg and beef tendon, sashimi, cutlets (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_saidokoro_yasukawa.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Sat 18:00–23:30; closed Sunday; hours and closed days may change, so check before visiting. Reservations taken — a November 2024 reviewer says they are a must. No credit cards (Tabelog). 14 seats: 6 at the counter, 8 at tables. Non-smoking. In the ザ・マインビル, down the first alley north off Sueyoshi-cho east of Hanamikoji (November 2024 review). The shop moved here before December 2023.
kyoto_saidokoro_yasukawa.notes: [Oden & obanzai · Gion north of Shijo, an alley counter] A cheerful 14-seat oden counter tucked down a Gion alley: light Kyoto oden at about ¥300 a piece, obanzai, cutlets and an oden-broth potato salad, or a ¥4,000 omakase course. Reasonable for Gion. Book ahead; no cards. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers since January 2023 describe a homey oden and obanzai shop that relocated within Gion before December 2023, with a cheerful owner who sees guests off and prices well below the Gion norm. Criticism: two reviewers found the oden broth too light or not fully soaked into every item (February and November 2024).
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto-style oden; oden potato salad; fried small potatoes.

anecdotes.text: April 2025: "Oh, and I also ordered the oden potato salad as an extra! It was like egg salad but with the flavor of oden broth—simply exquisite! This is a must-order!"
December 2023: "This was my first visit since they relocated, and the oden was just as good as ever, cooked in a wonderfully flavorful broth."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 菜処 やすかわ、おでん・日本料理、東山区祇園町北側347-133 ザ・マインビル 1F、月〜土18:00〜23:30、日曜休み、営業時間・定休日は変更の可能性あり、予約可、カード不可、14席 (カウンター6・テーブル8)、禁煙。口コミ (2023年1月〜2026年4月、英語): 移転後も変わらぬ京風のおでん (2023年12月)、大根・卵・こんにゃく・しらたき・ちくわ・がんも・牛すじ、1品300円で牛すじは少し高め (2026年4月)、おまかせコース4,000円 (おばんざい、刺身、おでん5品、揚げ物3品、ごはん1品、2025年4月)、おでんのポテトサラダ、だし巻き、小芋の揚げ物、コロッケ、ハムカツ、ヒレカツ、カキフライ、その場で握るおにぎり、まぐろのたたき、明るい店主、予約必須との声 (2024年11月)、だしが薄いとの声 (2024年2月・11月)。

kyoto_kawashige_sanjo.gf_detail: Ask. Dashi-based Kyoto kappo with fried fu and soy-seasoned dishes (2011–2025 reviews).
kyoto_kawashige_sanjo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi throughout, sashimi, hamo, squid (2011–2025 reviews).
kyoto_kawashige_sanjo.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 11:30–13:30 and 17:30–21:00; closed Mondays (Tabelog). No cover charge (Tabelog Japanese original 「チャージ料無し。」). Bento to order, with delivery (Tabelog); a 2024 regular says bento must be ordered ahead. 15 seats; a private room for 4 (Tabelog). Down a narrow alley off Kawaramachi south of Sanjo, 3 min from Sanjo (Tabelog; 2011 and July 2025 reviews).
kyoto_kawashige_sanjo.notes: [Kyoto kappo · Sanjo] A worn, quiet counter kappo down an alley off Kawaramachi-Sanjo, open since 1942 and among the first of its kind, still cooking bento for Gion tea houses: classic Kyoto courses from about ¥8,000, bento by order. About ¥15,000–20,000 at dinner.

chef_bio.background: Established in 1942, one of the pioneering counter kappo of Kyoto, which has trained many chefs and caters to Gion tea houses (September 2011 review); a July 2025 diner had heard it used to cater for Pontocho tea houses. Tabelog names Masako Shirasu, Shotaro Ikenami and Junichiro Tanizaki among those who loved it.
chef_bio.specialty: Counter kappo; bento for tea houses.

anecdotes.text: A July 2025 group dinner found the soup, grilled and simmered dishes rooted in sound training, but wished for more than one sake, Kiku Masamune.
A diner with memories going back 38 years still receives summer and New Year greetings from the shop, and recommends the bento ordered ahead (April 2024).
A November 2022 diner in kimono ate the shop's bento at a Gion tea house, down to the momiji tofu and kuzumochi.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 河しげ 三条本店、日本料理、中京区河原町通三条下る東入大黒町46、三条駅・京阪三条駅から徒歩3分、火〜日 11:30〜13:30・17:30〜21:00、月曜休み、チャージ料無し、15席、4人用の個室、仕出し弁当と配達、コースは8,000円から、Masako Shirasu・Shotaro Ikenami・Junichiro Tanizaki ゆかりの店 (紹介文、英訳)。口コミ (2008〜2025年、英語): 1942年創業、カウンター割烹の先駆け、祇園のお茶屋に仕出し、おまかせ15,000円から (2011年)、Akashi の鯛、鱧、トロ、aori いか、栗と銀杏、生麩の揚げ物、momiji 豆腐と葛餅の弁当 (2022年11月)、日本酒は2011年は Tamano Hikari、2025年7月は Kiku Masamune のみ。

cultural_comfort.note: Traditional counter kappo.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through July 2025.

kyoto_tonshabu_hide_shijo_karasuma.gf_detail: Ask. Shabu-shabu meat and vegetables, but ponzu, sesame and miso dipping sauces and the ramen to finish are wheat or soy-based (2014–2026 reviews).
kyoto_tonshabu_hide_shijo_karasuma.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork, beef and chicken shabu-shabu (2014–2026 reviews).
kyoto_tonshabu_hide_shijo_karasuma.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–14:00 (L.O. 13:30) and 17:00–22:00 (Tabelog). Bookings taken (Tabelog). No cover charge (Tabelog Japanese original 「チャージ料なし」). Cards and e-money (Tabelog). 80 seats, tables and sunken kotatsu; non-smoking, smoking near the entrance (Tabelog; February 2021 review). 2nd floor, 1 min from exit 15 of Karasuma / Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_tonshabu_hide_shijo_karasuma.notes: [Pork shabu-shabu · Shijo-Karasuma] A big, homely second-floor shabu-shabu room a minute from Karasuma, popular with overseas visitors: pork, chicken or beef with free refills of vegetables, cheap set courses and lunch hot pots. About ¥3,000–8,000.

chef_bio.background: The Shijo-Karasuma main shop of three (with 京都離れ店 and 心斎橋店; own site). Homely service by older women on the staff (November 2023 and January 2026 reviews); English greetings and many overseas guests (November 2018 and December 2022 reviews).

anecdotes.text: A New Year 2026 diner found the room nearly full by 6 pm and liked the older women on the staff and the free refills.
An April 2026 couple splurged on the pork, beef and chicken all-you-can-eat course and managed only one extra plate of beef.
A November 2023 diner who booked at the last minute was surprised by the warm welcome.

cultural_comfort.note: Staff greet in English; many overseas guests (2018 and 2022 reviews).

kyoto_cafe_loto_sanjo.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: madeleines, egg tarts, financiers, roll cake and tarts (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_cafe_loto_sanjo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: butter and egg baked sweets, café latte (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_cafe_loto_sanjo.hours_raw: Daily 10:00–18:00; hours may change (Tabelog). A February 2025 review gives Wed–Fri 12:00–18:00 and Sat 12:00–20:00. Seats upstairs require ordering food; drinks alone at the counter or the bench outside; shoes off upstairs (2025–26 reviews). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). One table for six upstairs and a bench in front (2025–26 reviews). On Komonmae Street among antique shops and galleries, near Sanjo (Tabelog; January 2026 review).
kyoto_cafe_loto_sanjo.notes: [Café · Komonmae Street] A tiny coffee stand in a renovated townhouse among the antique shops of Komonmae Street, by a cookery researcher: espresso drinks and fresh madeleines, egg tarts and seasonal cakes, with one shared table upstairs (shoes off) or a bench outside. About ¥1,000–2,000.

chef_bio.background: Opened 23 February 2023; a café of the cookery researcher Masayo Takeda (February 2025 review), who also heads a culinary research institute (January 2026 review). Designed by the architect Yasushi Horibe, which draws architecture fans (February 2026 review). Latte-art events (August 2025 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Madeleines and egg tarts with coffee.

anecdotes.text: After a Mika Ninagawa exhibition at the Kyoto City KYOCERA Museum of Art (March 2025), a visitor had a madeleine and café latte on the bench outside.
A March 2025 visitor who rarely eats egg tarts was won over by a burst of vanilla.
A January 2026 visitor arrived just as the madeleines came out of the oven and took more away.

kyoto_the_door_takakura.gf_detail: Ask. A bar with a full food menu — carbonara, katsu sandwich, omurice — mostly wheat; cheese and nuts may suit (2018–2026 reviews).
kyoto_the_door_takakura.vegan_detail: Ask. Drinks and mixed nuts; most food is meat, egg or cheese (2018–2026 reviews).
kyoto_the_door_takakura.hours_raw: Daily 18:00–02:00; irregular closures (Tabelog); last order 2 am (May 2026 review). Bookings taken (Tabelog). Cover charge ¥600 (Tabelog Japanese original 「チャージ600円」). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money (Tabelog). 31 seats: 9 at the counter, 22 at tables, private rooms upstairs; smoking allowed (Tabelog; May 2025 review). In a remodelled townhouse on Takakura just south of Shijo, by Daimaru (Tabelog).
kyoto_the_door_takakura.notes: [Machiya bar · Shijo-Takakura] A bar in a remodelled townhouse by Daimaru, with a counter and small garden downstairs and private rooms upstairs: single-malt highballs, cocktails and a surprisingly full food menu until 2 am. Smoking allowed. About ¥3,000–6,000.

chef_bio.background: Opened 23 September 2010 (Tabelog). A remodelled townhouse; the small garden behind the counter was designed by Katsuaki Ogawa, son of the 11th-generation Ogawa Jihei (Tabelog). A sister bar, The door Horikawa, is in the Tabelog crawl.

anecdotes.text: On a May 2025 bar crawl, turned away from a famous bar next door, a visitor let the bartender choose single-malt highballs and talked Hanshin baseball with the next customer.
A May 2026 visitor came after the last train for carbonara and a ¥1,600 kiwi cooler — about ¥6,000 for two.
On the first night of an October 2025 weekend in Kyoto, a visitor made it a fourth stop for a martini and a Royal Lochnagar twice up.

cultural_comfort.note: Bar; smoking allowed.

kyoto_bar_rm_gion.hours_raw: MEMBERS ONLY: described as a members-only, invitation-only bar (November 2024; October 2026) — entry by intercom up a narrow stair (March 2024); go with a member or ask about introduction. kyoto_bar_rm_gion.notes: [Members-only cocktail bar · Gion Shirakawa] A six-seat, members-only bar up a narrow stair in a renovated wooden house at the end of a Gion alley — ring the intercom. Go with a member. ¥800 charge; closed Tuesday; smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Per reviews: a hidden Gion bar, described in 2024–26 reviews as members-only and invitation-only, in a renovated traditional wooden house; an October 2026 visitor says chefs from across Japan come here.

anecdotes.text: A March 2024 visitor was taken by a friend, rang the intercom, climbed the narrow stairs and had time for just two cocktails before a train.
An October 2026 visitor found customers arriving steadily until late and praised bartender Murakami.
A November 2024 visitor tried scotches and brandies never met before.

kyoto_gion_uemori.notes: [Yudofu and yuba kaiseki · Gion] A calm restaurant in a lane just off Hanamikoji, with a small counter downstairs and private rooms up a steep stair, serving reasonably priced kaiseki built on yudofu and yuba — freshly lifted yuba with wasabi, Morika tofu, hiro-usu, tempura, chirimen-sansho rice — at lunch and dinner. Book ahead; no service charge.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a Japanese restaurant just off Hanamikoji with counter, tables and four private rooms upstairs; reviewers return for its yudofu and yuba kaiseki.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 traveller, panicking on a year-end Monday when many places were shut, found it and was surprised by the yuba.
A May 2026 diner on a third visit always orders the yudofu and yuba kaiseki as a meal for a tired body.
An April 2026 guest called the first plate — freshly lifted yuba with fresh wasabi and dashi — the highlight.

UnionPay); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 25 seats: a 7-seat counter, a sunken-kotatsu room for 2–6 and an upstairs tatami room for 2–16 (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). kyoto_kyoryori_oyone.notes: [Kyoto cuisine · Ayanokoji, since 1927] A quiet, nearly century-old Kyoto-cuisine restaurant on Ayanokoji near Daimaru, with a counter, a sunken-kotatsu room and an upstairs tatami room, keeping to traditional flavours made by hand — seasonal courses such as matsutake dobin-mushi and hassun. It says it will adapt for dietary restrictions. 10% service (15% in rooms); closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened in December 1927 by the first generation in this area; it keeps to traditional Kyoto flavours with time-honoured, handmade methods while adding new initiatives.
chef_bio.philosophy: Traditional Kyoto flavour, made with care by hand; each guest’s needs met, from celebrations to dietary restrictions (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: An October 2025 business lunch for five felt like a dinner, from crab and matsutake dobin-mushi to chestnut wagashi.

kyoto_gion_juen.notes: [Sukiyaki and shabu-shabu · Gion by Yasaka Shrine, A5 Omi beef] A calm second-floor Wagyu restaurant on the street to Yasaka Shrine, serving A5 Omi beef from a Shiga farm as sukiyaki (from one person at lunch), shabu-shabu or steamed seiro, plus a big hamburg steak and a vegetarian set. Sets from ¥4,980, courses ¥6,600–11,000. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Run by 株式会社ネクスト, registered in the same building (NTA register). The shop’s site describes a Wagyu specialist in Gion. Reviewers say the Omi beef comes direct from a farm in Shiga (April–August 2026) and that the staff cooked the sukiyaki for a group that asked in advance (September 2026).

anecdotes.text: A group of four men in the 70s age bracket, unsure how to cook sukiyaki, asked when booking for staff to cook it, and a staff member did (September 2026).

kyoto_yakitori_no_waraiya.notes: [Yakitori · Tomikoji by Shijo, binchotan and good cheer] A friendly yakitori house a short walk from the Shijo crossing, grilling Kyoto Akadori over binchotan for about 30 years. Six chef’s-choice skewers ¥1,500, plus unusually good vegetable dishes; courses from ¥4,000 with an all-you-can-drink option. A lively manager at the counter; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: The shop says it has grilled yakitori over binchotan for about 30 years, using rare cuts of Kyoto Akadori, with organic and local vegetables (Tabelog). Reviewers (2024–2026) describe a friendly owner and an energetic manager who chats in Kansai dialect at the counter.
chef_bio.specialty: Binchotan yakitori with house salt or tare.

anecdotes.text: A June 2025 diner, asked to move from a table to the counter for a group, was given complimentary drinks by the owner.
A March 2026 couple at the counter were chatted to in lively Kansai dialect by the manager, who recommended liver and shiso skewers.
An October 2026 regular calls it a friend’s restaurant, visited on every trip home to Kyoto.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: やきとりの笑い屋、居酒屋・焼鳥、京都市下京区富小路通四条下ル徳正寺42、烏丸駅から徒歩5分、17:00〜23:00 (L.O.フード22:30)、火曜定休、12月31日・1月1日休み、予約可、カード・電子マネー可、お通し350円 (税込)、25席 (カウンター5、テーブル20)、分煙、創業約30年、備長炭でじっくり焼く、京赤地鶏や若鶏の希少部位、独自ブレンドの塩と秘伝のタレ、有機野菜や地元の食材、団体も。口コミ (2023〜2026年、英語): おまかせ6本盛り1,500円、ホルモン天ぷら680円、お通しにおでん、4,000円のコースと90分飲み放題1,500円、しあわせサラダ、ポテトサラダ、カキフライ、だし巻、唐揚げ、締めのラーメン、元気な店長と関西弁、気さくな店主。

cultural_comfort.note: Cards accepted; friendly counter.

kyoto_stand_umineko_koto.gf_detail: Not GF: a craft-beer bar; snacks include spring rolls and kara-age (reviews).
kyoto_stand_umineko_koto.vegan_detail: Ask. Snacks include three kinds of potato salad, spring rolls and octopus with avocado (2026 reviews).
kyoto_stand_umineko_koto.hours_raw: Monday–Friday 16:00–23:00; Saturday, Sunday and holidays 13:00–23:00; food last order around 21:30; closing days not fixed (Tabelog; March 2026). Cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). A standing counter for about 10, plus one table at the back; non-smoking (Tabelog; April 2026). Run by Derailleur Brew Works of Nishinari, Osaka, in a renovated townhouse (2026 reviews). Near Shijo Karasuma (Tabelog address; June 2026).
kyoto_stand_umineko_koto.notes: [Craft beer · near Shijo Karasuma, an Osaka brewery's stand] A standing craft-beer bar in a renovated townhouse, run by Nishinari's Derailleur Brew Works: its own Riot Ale and guest taps by the 260 ml glass (¥900), plus cans. Clever snacks — three kinds of potato salad, smoked mentaiko. Opens at 13:00 at weekends.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers (2026) describe a stand run directly by Derailleur Brew Works, a brewery in Nishinari, Osaka, pouring its own beers and guest beers in a renovated Kyoto townhouse; staff explain the difference between house and guest beers.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 second-time visitor made the 21:30 food order just in time for the ethnic potato salad.
An April 2026 traveller changing trains in Kyoto stopped for two small glasses and octopus with avocado.
An October 2026 regular noted the prices had risen since the last visit.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: スタンドうみねこ コト、ビアバー、京都市中京区蛸屋町160-3、月〜金 16:00〜23:00、土日祝 13:00〜23:00、不定休、カード・電子マネー・QR可、立ち飲みカウンター10人ほど、禁煙。口コミ (2026年、英語): 大阪・西成の Derailleur Brew Works の直営、町家を改装、自社と他社のタップ (20〜35)、缶も多い、S (260ml) 900円・M (330ml) 1,200円・L (473ml) 1,700円、西成ライオットエール、ウエストコーストIPA、ポーター、3種のポテトサラダ、燻製明太子、春巻き、唐揚げ、タコとアボカド、フードのL.O.は21:30ごろ、奥にテーブル1つ、値上がり。

cultural_comfort.note: Standing bar; cards accepted; staff explain the beers.

kyoto_sumibi_sakaba_muragon.gf_detail: Ask. Charcoal yakitori, oden, sobameshi and yakisoba on the teppan, fried chicken; no gluten information is published (reviews).
kyoto_sumibi_sakaba_muragon.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a yakitori and chicken izakaya (Tabelog).
kyoto_sumibi_sakaba_muragon.hours_raw: 18:00–24:00; closed Tuesday and one irregular day a month (Tabelog). Reservations by phone (October 2024). Cards accepted; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 20 seats: a 7–8-seat counter downstairs and tables upstairs for groups; non-smoking (Tabelog; October 2025). On Tomikoji south of Ayanokoji (Tabelog).
kyoto_sumibi_sakaba_muragon.notes: [Yakitori · Tomikoji south of Shijo, charcoal and teppan] A small two-floor charcoal yakitori bar opened in 2023: skewers from about ¥250, chicken sashimi, grilled abura-age, and sobameshi sizzling on a teppan, with plenty of sake and awamori. Counter downstairs, tables upstairs; closed Tuesday; open to midnight.

chef_bio.background: Opened in August 2023 (Tabelog). Reviewers (2023–2026) describe a friendly owner-chef who loves food and talk, and an October 2025 reviewer says the owner previously managed another yakitori restaurant before going independent.

anecdotes.text: A June 2025 visitor saw the congratulatory gift bags from the opening still on display, near the second anniversary.
A July 2024 regular ordered the chicken sashimi three times.
A July 2026 party was taken there by a classmate of the owner and toasted with Kanemitsu soda.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 炭火酒場 むらごん、鶏料理・焼鳥・おでん、京都市下京区富小路綾小路下る塗師屋町92-2、火曜定休、月1回不定休、18:00〜24:00、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、20席 (1階カウンター8、2階テーブル)、禁煙、2023年8月10日オープン。口コミ (2023〜2026年、英語): 串5本盛り1,200円 (ハツ、レバー、砂肝、ぼんじり、ささみ)、おでん・椎茸・銀杏・名物の唐揚げ250円、鶏刺し、鶏のたたき、とようけ屋の油揚げの炭火焼き、鉄板のそばめし、焼きそば、豆腐ステーキ、日本酒と泡盛、トマト酢の焼酎ハイボール、気さくな店主、2周年。

cultural_comfort.note: Cards accepted; counter downstairs.

kyoto_pontako_sakura.vegan_detail: Not vegan: octopus takoyaki, beef tendon, duck and meat tofu (reviews).
kyoto_pontako_sakura.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); closed Tuesday; hours as updated on 19 August 2026 (Tabelog). Reservations taken during opening hours (Tabelog). Cards, Suica-type e-money and PayPay accepted (Tabelog). ¥300 appetizer charge, even without alcohol (Tabelog; July 2023). 21 seats: a 7-seat counter downstairs; a private room for 6 and two tables upstairs; non-smoking (Tabelog). Takoyaki to take away from the front (2018–2026 reviews). In a renovated townhouse on Pontocho next to Pontocho Park, 5 min from Sanjo, Gion-Shijo or Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; January 2026).
kyoto_pontako_sakura.notes: [Takoyaki bar · Pontocho, by the park] A stylish takoyaki and teppan bar in a renovated townhouse by Pontocho Park: small, dashi-rich takoyaki by the four or six with sauce, dashi soy or Andean salt, and wine to match — or two beef-tendon takoyaki to go for ¥300. Counter downstairs, tables upstairs; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers (2018–2026) describe a takoyaki shop in a renovated Pontocho townhouse with dim lighting and jazz, run by a talkative master, selling takeaway takoyaki at the front and pairing creative takoyaki with wine inside.

anecdotes.text: A September 2022 guest took the master’s advice to add special mayonnaise and Andean pink salt.
A January 2026 passer-by on the way to a gathering was drawn in by the smell and bought two beef-tendon takoyaki for ¥300.
A December 2023 diner had negitoro-topped takoyaki like gunkan sushi, with wine, as in an Italian course.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ぽんたこ 佐倉、鉄板焼き・ダイニングバー、京都市中京区先斗町通若松町141-13、京阪祇園四条駅・阪急京都河原町駅・京阪三条駅から徒歩5分、17:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、火曜定休 (2026年8月19日から)、予約は営業時間内、カード・交通系電子マネー・PayPay可、お通し300円、21席 (1階カウンター7、2階個室6名・4名テーブル2)、禁煙。口コミ (2018〜2026年、英語): 町家を改装したおしゃれなたこ焼き屋、先斗町公園の隣、持ち帰り可、4個か6個、だし醤油・塩・マヨネーズ、ダブルチーズ、明太子、ねぎとろのせ、牛すじたこ焼き2個300円、肉豆腐、ポン酢のジュレ、鴨、ワイン、アンデスの塩、話好きのマスター。

cultural_comfort.note: Cards accepted; takeaway at the front.

kyoto_konno_yumiyacho.gf_detail: Ask. A Kyoto omakase with dashi, soy and nagaimo somen; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_konno_yumiyacho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish, crab, eel, chicken and beef courses (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_konno_yumiyacho.hours_raw: Tuesday–Sunday 18:00–23:00; closed Monday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, same-day by enquiry; a booking is cancelled if no contact 30 minutes after the time (Tabelog). A seven-dish lunch has been served (December 2025). Service charge 5%, 10% after 21:00 (Tabelog original サービス料5％・21時以降は10％). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Eight counter seats; private hire (Tabelog). Non-smoking; please avoid strong perfume (Tabelog). Children by arrangement (Tabelog). Seasonal hot-pot sets to take home, ordered via the website or Instagram (Tabelog). 7–8 min walk from Kiyomizu-Gojo or Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 24 April 2025 (Tabelog).
kyoto_konno_yumiyacho.notes: [Kyoto cuisine with wine · Yamatooji-Matsubara, 8 seats] A quiet eight-seat counter, opened in 2025 near Miyagawa-cho, where a chef trained at Gion's Hassun cooks classical Kyoto dishes to go with wine — some ten by the glass and champagne from magnums — and the owner, once a Gion Kobu geiko, hosts. Service charge rises from 5% to 10% after 9 p.m. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a quiet Japanese restaurant of eight counter seats opened 24 April 2025, with wines, Kyoto and Yamagata sake and magnum champagne by the glass chosen by a sommelier owner, and hospitality from the owner, once a geiko in Gion Kobu. Reviewers in October 2025 and August 2026 say the chef trained at Hassun in Gion; an April 2026 reviewer says the chef holds a sommelier certificate.
chef_bio.philosophy: Classical Japanese food paired with wine (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 solo lunch guest started with a warming chawanmushi instead of cold starters, then koppe crab peeled for the guest, with champagne from a magnum.
An April 2026 private party had a spring course built on flower sansho — eel, chicken shabu-shabu in sansho broth — after sea urchin, firefly squid and abalone.
An August 2026 diner found the cooking traditional and dashi-led, ingredients allowed to speak, at a comfortable distance from the chef.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理、東山区大和大路通松原下る弓矢町38、清水五条駅・祇園四条駅から徒歩7〜8分、火〜日 18:00〜23:00、月曜休み、予約可 (当日も相談可、30分連絡なしはキャンセル扱い)、サービス料5% (21時以降は10%)、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、カウンター8席、貸切可、禁煙、香水など強い香りは控えて、子どもは相談、季節の鍋セットの販売 (公式サイト・Instagram)、2025年4月24日開店、宮川町と祇園の近くの静かな日本料理店、ソムリエの店主が選ぶグラスワイン約10種、京都と山形の日本酒、マグナムのグラスシャンパン、祇園甲部の元芸妓の店主のもてなし。口コミ (2025年9月〜2026年8月、英語): 料理人は祇園の Hassun で修業 (2025年10月、2026年8月)、料理人はソムリエの資格も (2026年4月)、7品の昼 (2025年12月)、茶碗蒸し、こっぺ蟹、選べる果物のデザート、山椒の春のコース (雲丹、ほたるいか、鮑、蛤の椀、鰻、山椒のだしの鶏しゃぶ)、長芋そうめん、八寸、鱧の造り、牛肉の主菜。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter of eight; no strong perfume; service 5%, 10% after 21:00; cards.

kyoto_sauna_izakaya_sanjo.gf_detail: Not GF: pasta, terrine and cheesecake on the menu (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sauna_izakaya_sanjo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: wagyu bolognese, salmon cream pasta and liver pudding (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sauna_izakaya_sanjo.hours_raw: Monday and Wednesday–Friday 17:00–23:00; Saturday 15:00–23:00; Sunday 15:00–22:00; closed Tuesday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted and advised — often full (Tabelog; February 2026). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Counter seats downstairs and more on upper floors, three levels in all; private hire (Tabelog; February 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Weak phone signal inside (January 2026). Just north of Kawaramachi-Sanjo; about 190 m from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog; October 2026). Opened 19 May 2023 (Tabelog).
kyoto_sauna_izakaya_sanjo.notes: [Izakaya · Kawaramachi-Sanjo, sauna-themed] A playful three-floor izakaya dressed as a sauna — wood panelling, sauna hats, lockers — from the team behind OFURO: pretty, wine-friendly plates like liver pudding, taro-and-sansho terrine and wagyu bolognese, with house cocktails. Friendly staff; book ahead. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per reviewers: the sister restaurant of OFURO (kyoto_ofuro_sanjo), sharing some staff, styled like a sauna and public bath though there is no actual sauna, on three floors with counter seating (November 2025–October 2026). Opened 19 May 2023 (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 OFURO regular finally tried the iced cheesecake — crunchy half-frozen, creamy as it warms — and found some of the same friendly staff.
A January 2026 diner at the counter loved a sake-and-Calpis cocktail but got no phone signal for two hours — fine for a digital detox.
A November 2025 visitor, after a massage, enjoyed the sauna hats and locker-style decor of a sauna without the sauna.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋、中京区恵比須町534-33、京都市役所前駅から185m、月・水〜金 17:00〜23:00、土 15:00〜23:00、日 15:00〜22:00、火曜休み、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、貸切可、禁煙、2023年5月19日開店。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年10月、英語): OFURO の姉妹店 (スタッフも一部共通)、サウナや銭湯をイメージした木の内装、サウナハットやロッカー、3階建てでカウンター中心、前菜の盛り合わせ、ポテトサラダ、椎茸のマリネ、里芋と山椒のテリーヌ、大人のレバープリン、きのこのムース、和牛のボロネーゼ、鮭ときのこのクリームパスタ、アイスチーズケーキ、ワイン、ハイボール、緑茶ハイ、日本酒のカルピス割り、予約がおすすめ、店内は電波が弱い (2026年1月)、5品と2杯で4,000円ほど (2025年12月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; weak phone signal; cards, IC and QR.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_sushi_nao_gion.gf_detail: Ask. Edo-style sushi with soy and simmered clam; no gluten information (2008–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sushi_nao_gion.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sushi counter (2008–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sushi_nao_gion.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday 18:00–2:00; closed Sunday and holiday Mondays; hours may change (Tabelog). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). About six to eight counter seats and a small table at the back; no photos (2008–2011 reviews). Gion Shinbashi, a short walk east of Hanamikoji (2008–2011 reviews).
kyoto_sushi_nao_gion.notes: [Sushi · Gion Shinbashi, late] A tiny, long-running Gion sushi counter open until 2 a.m., where you order from the day's fish laid out in a wooden box — flounder, chu-toro, swordfish — rather than a fixed course. Regulars rave about the fish and the rice-to-topping balance; others found the service curt. No photos. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per reviewers: a small Edo-style sushi counter just east of Hanamikoji in Gion Shinbashi, reviewed since 2008, run in 2008 by the chef with one woman assisting; known for buying fine fish (2008–2019 reviews).

anecdotes.text: An October 2008 visitor praised the choice of fish — flounder, chu-toro and swordfish — over a glass of Cristal, and noted there was no set course.
An April 2019 regular called the rice-to-fish balance perfect and the fish unmatched anywhere else.
A February 2020 guest found the service unpleasant and would not return.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 寿司、東山区橋本町403、三条京阪から415m、月〜土 18:00〜翌2:00、日曜休み、祝日の月曜休み、カード (JCB・AMEX・Diners) 可。口コミ (2008年1月〜2026年6月、英語): 祇園新橋の花見小路の少し東、カウンター6〜8席と奥に小さなテーブル、写真は控えるよう頼まれる (2011年)、その日の魚を木箱に並べる、コースでなく好みで、平目、中とろ、かじき、煮蛤、納豆巻き、シャンパン、店主と女性一人 (2008年)、魚とシャリの釣り合いがよい (2019年4月)、接客が不快だったとの声 (2020年2月)、高いが価値ある握り (2026年6月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Small counter of regulars; no photos; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners).

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews in January 2025 and June 2026.

kyoto_bar_bunkyu.gf_detail: A cocktail and whisky bar with no food described; spirits like whisky are generally gluten-free — ask about beer and mixers (2013–2025 reviews).
kyoto_bar_bunkyu.vegan_detail: Drinks only — cocktails of seasonal fruit and Scotch (2015–2018 reviews).
kyoto_bar_bunkyu.hours_raw: Tuesday, Friday and Saturday 20:00–24:00; closed other days; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). No cards (Tabelog). About seven to nine seats around one large wooden table; private hire up to 20 (Tabelog; 2015 reviews). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). Very dark inside (2013–2025 reviews). At the end of a narrow alley off the street north of Kawaramachi-Sanjo, behind a noren reading "bar Bunkyu" (2013–2025 reviews).
kyoto_bar_bunkyu.notes: [Bar · Kawaramachi-Sanjo alley, Tue/Fri/Sat] A near-dark bar inside an old storehouse at the end of a narrow alley: one big rounded wooden table, a bartender mixing cocktails from seasonal fruit to suit you, and Scotch. Look for the "bar Bunkyu" noren. Open three nights a week from 8 p.m.; cash only; smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Per reviewers: a bar in a storehouse a December 2013 reviewer dates to the first year of the Bunkyu era, once used by a flower shop; a February 2018 reviewer says it is produced by the Kyoto florist Hanamasa, with a bartender, Nao, who makes cocktails from seasonal fruit and world spirits. A March 2015 guest saw foreign guests looked after in fluent English.

anecdotes.text: An August 2025 traveller, emboldened by a few drinks, followed a noren reading only "bar Bunkyu" down a narrow alley to a small door.
A March 2015 guest found it so dark the eyes needed time to adjust to the rounded wooden table, and was seen to the door after two Scotches.
An October 2019 reviewer liked the dark, small room and reasonable drinks but felt the bartender chooses customers.
